home_lead: Every dive, every setting, every zone, up to the 3D model of the submerged lock.
home_alt: Render of the 3D model of zone 12 seen from the west, sunlight rays falling through the water: masonry pier, spillway sluice gates and walkway, covered in zebra mussels
home_about: Lock 21 has been underwater since 1958, at Dickinson's Landing, one of the Lost Villages of the St. Lawrence. I set out to digitize the whole structure in 3D, zone by zone, with photogrammetry. This site is the field notebook: it shows the lock to people who don't dive, helps divers plan their dives, and documents the method so others can do it elsewhere.
home_startSub: Three ways in, depending on what brings you here.
model_model1: Lock 21 at Dickinson's Landing, under the St. Lawrence since 1958, surveyed zone by zone with underwater photogrammetry. Every zone is assembled into a single model; the zones not yet digitised are added dive after dive. The ground around is modelled, not surveyed.

viewer_swimHelpText:
Underwater, you move like a diver, where you look.

  • {w} forward, {s} back
  • {a} left, {d} right
  • the arrow keys do the same; so does the mouse wheel, forward and back
  • hold Shift: faster
  • mouse button held down, drag: turn your head (up, down, left, right)

The {icon} button or the Esc key brings back the usual navigation.
viewer_keysHelpText:
With the mouse:

  • left button, drag: turn around the point pressed
  • right button, drag: pan
  • wheel: zoom
  • double-click: fly to that point

The keys move the camera in the direction it looks.

  • {w} forward, {s} back
  • {a} left, {d} right
  • hold Shift: faster

The arrow keys ↑ ↓ ← → can be used too.
viewer_touchHelp:
• one finger: turn
  • two fingers: move around, and pinch to zoom toward your fingers
  • double-tap: move closer to that point
